supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: Visible extension of the ridge boundary beyond the outer lateral margins of the eyes

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: High contrast between a significantly lighter/greyer muzzle region and dark, high-intensity periocular and cheek zones

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: Thin, neutral horizontal line with minimal vertical protrusion or structural droop

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive grey/white hair growth on the mental (chin) region forming a distinct beard
